name: 透明浴帘内衬易洁通透款
description: 透明内衬挂位、易洁擦洗微距、空表选码与空白印章材质信任

styleLock.backgroundSystem: bright field #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, sage green block #A9C0A4 and deep pine panel #4C6B57 for overlay cards, pale limestone #EDEAE4 for material and layout boards
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral studio light, soft front key with a bounce fill, gentle contact shadow under the hem, controlled glossy highlights on the transparent sheet, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale limestone #EDEAE4 counter, veined light stone wall #E9E6E1, soft grey floor tile #DDDEDA
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, reserved for downstream copy only; every text area in this template renders as an empty rail or blank block
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in one accent, rounded seal frames left empty
styleLock.presentationRules: the liner hangs full height from a polished metal rod with C-shaped hooks, straight stable scale, soft even drape, overlays never cover more than half the product
noDrift: no rendered brand marks, seals or numbers inside overlay shapes
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean bathroom textile visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of bright field #FFFFFF, sage green block #A9C0A4, deep pine green panel #4C6B57 and pale limestone #EDEAE4; neutral studio lighting with a soft front key, bounce fill and gentle contact shadow; modern geometric sans-serif kept out of the frame so all copy areas stay empty; rounded solid arch and card overlays with generous empty label rails; thin single-weight line icons; stable hanging scale and soft even drape; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底挂杆整幅通透帘身＋鼠尾草绿拱形色块主张位；002 深绿圆角信息卡＋红色空白角标位＋三个线性图标标签行；003 儿童在帘后玩泡泡＋绿色拱带双行标题位与四项留空无添加清单带红叉圆徽；004 表面水珠成珠＋戴手套的手用超纤布擦洗微距；005 人物背影在浴缸看书透过帘身＋拱形色带标题位；006 石纹墙＋挂杆鸡眼孔与棕色放大镜圈标注；007 白底整幅帘身右侧纵向尺寸线标注数字；008 分组规格表格标题板并带原品牌字标；009 浴缸边下摆内嵌配重放大镜圈与数量字样；010 花洒淋浴背影＋圆形水珠内嵌圈。品类判定：产品为挂在装饰帘内侧的透明浴帘内衬（无电加热/电机的小件卫浴布艺），故归「家居日用/卫浴用品」，未按源平台常见错挂类目处理；与库内另一款透明磁吸浴帘的差异化在本套独有分镜——易洁擦洗微距、家庭嬉水与留空无添加清单、空白印章框信任收口、分组空表选码矩阵、透过帘身的泡澡阅读场景。已剥离：原品牌字标与系列字样、认证与无添加具体名称、全部尺寸与数量数字（改为空白印章框、空表格单元、无值尺寸线）、图内全部原文案原句（仅保留版式结构）、可辨识面容（童模仅保留侧后方与泡泡遮挡、成人仅颈部以下或背影）。
